settings.hero_desc: A detailed model of a shipping-container restaurant - fold-out awning, outdoor seating, upper deck and stairs - on a finished base. The ideal way to pitch an F&B or pop-up concept to investors and franchisees.
settings.perso_placeholder: Your concept, branding, layout and base
settings.s1_body: A container restaurant concept is far more convincing in 3D. This model recreates the unit - container body, fold-out awning, terrace seating and an upper deck - so investors, landlords and franchisees can see exactly how the space works and flows. Built from your design, it's a compelling pitch and presentation piece for F&B and pop-up concepts.
settings.case_body: Built to pitch a container-restaurant concept, this model let the founders show investors and landlords exactly how the space worked - bringing the idea to life far better than drawings on a deck.
settings.case_quote: It brought our concept to life. Investors could finally picture the whole experience.
settings.prov_p: An F&B concept lives or dies on whether people can picture it. A detailed model lets investors and partners walk around the idea and believe in it.
